seoTitle: Physical Therapy in Oshkosh, WI | Fox Valley Physical Therapy
seoDescription: One-on-one physical therapy in Oshkosh since 1990, with the only therapeutic pool in town. No referral needed, and most insurance accepted.
heroText: Physical Therapy with same-day appointments available. We accept HSA, FSA, and most insurance, and private-pay bundles are available.
approachTitle: A Better Approach To Physical Therapy
approachText: Fox Valley Physical Therapy & Wellness Clinic was started by Steve and Regina Sobojinski in a 500-square-foot office in 1990. Today it's a 7,500 square foot clinic with the only therapeutic pool in the area, a fully equipped gym, and a team with more than 100 years of combined experience. We have been recognized as the best physical therapy clinic in Winnebago County.
approachCaptionText: "I treat their injuries as if they were my injuries."

benefits.title: A Plan Built Around You
benefits.text: Your therapist builds your treatment plan around your goals and adjusts it as you progress, so every visit is spent on what helps you most.

benefits.title: Call and Schedule Directly
benefits.text: Call to schedule, no referral needed. Our front office assists with all insurance questions and maximizes your benefits.

benefits.title: The Only Therapeutic Pool In Oshkosh
benefits.text: Aquatic therapy for arthritis, joint replacements, balance and pain, right here in the clinic.

benefits.title: We Talk To Your Doctor
benefits.text: We keep your referring provider in the loop on your progress, and we call them directly if your plan needs to change.

benefits.title: Same Day Services Available
benefits.text: No two week or longer wait.

teamText: Physical therapists, an occupational therapist, a physical therapist assistant and a licensed athletic trainer, with more than 100 years of combined experience.
poolTitle: The Only Therapeutic Pool In Oshkosh
poolText:
Exercising in water because of buoyancy, unloads healing joints so you can start moving and strengthening sooner and with less pain. It's a great fit for arthritis, rehab after surgery or joint replacement, balance problems and chronic back pain.

Finished with therapy? Current and former patients can schedule private pool sessions for {poolPrice} a month.
visitTitle: Visit Us At Our Oshkosh Location
visitText: Free parking right out front on S Washburn Street. Download the intake form ahead of time to save a few minutes at check-in.
